parsed.text: This packet contains two panels (p0, p1). Each panel gives current 4×4 location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3 and three conditional candidate records (k0,k1,k2). Copied or completed prior records in the packet are not new estimates; candidate/conditional command records are hypothetical branches, not events that have occurred. Current (p0): n0 — blue peaks at cell (0,1), red at (0,3); n1 and n2 — uniform over all 16 cells; n3 — blue peaks at (1,2), red peaks at (0,1). Current (p1): n0 — blue (0,1) and red (0,3); n1,n2,n3 — uniform. Conditional differences: many candidate k0 entries match the current concentrated patterns at n0 (blue (0,1), red (0,3)) and uniform n1/n2; p0 k1 changes n3 to a 2×2 blue block at {(0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3)} and a 2×2 red block at {(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)}; p0 k2 makes p0 n3 uniform. In p1 candidates, k1 gives a 2×2 blue block and 2×2 red block at n3, k2 gives blue peak (1,2) and red peak (0,1). No physical inferences are made; numbers describe distributions only.
